title: Stolen AI Reasoning Could Help China Build Cheaper Rivals
description: A flaw in OpenAI's context compaction process allowed researchers to transfer reasoning traces between AI models, enabling the cheaper distillation of rival AI models. This technique, called compaction smuggling, bypassed initial mitigations and was fixed by OpenAI in October 2026. The vulnerability enabled extraction of proprietary reasoning data from advanced models and its reuse in weaker models, facilitating large-scale copying of AI capabilities. This has been exploited by Chinese entities to develop competitive AI systems, raising national security concerns.
